name: The Mercy of Ash
relation_to_church: Part of the Church, highly independent, with its own courts, prisons and bounty chests. Rivals of the Holy Judges, not their contractors, and not under kings.
specialism: Hunting Veil sorceresses. Not every female mage is hunted: kings keep court sorceresses, and going after one causes political turmoil unless a king pays for a Sealed Writ (legal assassination). A neutral city may extort a Tolerance Tithe instead of a pyre.
methods: No magic and no Witch-Sight. Mundane inspection, informants, pricking, salt, cold water, heat, and stripping exams. They call burning a mercy, which echoes the Ashen Coast mercy sacrifices.
membership: Ordinary trained men. A magic-using female witch hunter is not part of the order as written; she may appear later as a special NPC only.
sources: lore/era_1670.json (Ashen Coast witch_scares and mercy sacrifices)
